hero.title: From Concept to Market
hero.lead: Unikota turns tissue and hygiene product ideas into market-ready products—from concept and packaging development through manufacturing, fulfilment, retail support, distribution and export coordination.

pillars.title: Products
pillars.body: Facial tissue, toilet rolls, kitchen towels and napkins for retail and business supply.

pillars.title: OEM, Customization & Export
pillars.body: Private-label manufacturing, custom packaging and container-load export supply.

pillars.title: Request a Proposal
pillars.body: Talk to our team about supply, OEM manufacturing or corporate gifting requirements.

trust.note: Unikota supports Malaysian retail and business supply through its own brands — Cili, Wasabi, Unisoft and Aimishu — while also handling OEM, private-label and bulk supply requirements. Detailed manufacturing capability information is available during proposal discussions.

ctaBand.title: Ready to talk?
ctaBand.body: Request a proposal or contact our team directly.

items.title: Retailers & Distributors
items.body: Own-brand and private-label tissue supply, replenishment and range support for retail and wholesale channels.

items.title: OEM & Private-Label Brands
items.body: Product development, packaging design and manufacturing for brands launching or expanding a tissue range.

items.title: Corporate & Institutional Buyers
items.body: Office, facility and institutional tissue supply, with customised options for organisations.

items.title: Hospitality & Food Service
items.body: Serviettes and tissue formats suited to restaurants, cafés, hotels and food-service operations.

items.title: Events, Campaigns & Corporate Gifting
items.body: Customised tissue boxes, packs and branded serviettes for events, campaigns and gifting programmes.

items.title: Export Buyers
items.body: Container-load supply and export coordination for overseas importers and distributors.

lanes.title: Own Brands & Supply
lanes.body: Unikota manufactures and supplies tissue and paper-hygiene products through its own brands — Cili, Wasabi, Unisoft and Aimishu — alongside wholesale, retail, corporate and export requirements.

process.title: From Concept to Market

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: Understand the commercial objective, intended audience and target market.

steps.title: Develop
steps.body: Define the product format, specification, pack size, quantity and packaging requirements.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Develop and finalise packaging concepts and production artwork.

steps.title: Manufacture
steps.body: Produce and pack the agreed product through Unikota's production capabilities and manufacturing network.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: Coordinate warehousing, logistics and delivery to designated warehouses, outlets or distribution points.

steps.title: Support the Market
steps.body: Assist with retail-listing preparation, distribution planning and export coordination where required.

process.note: Retail acceptance remains subject to the relevant retailer's approval.

corporate.title: Corporate, Institutional & Event Solutions
corporate.intro: Unikota develops customised tissue products and packaging around the customer's brand, audience, product format, quantity and delivery requirements. Projects can range from private-label product launches to corporate gifts, events and limited-edition campaigns.
items: Licensed-brand projects where rights are approved

broaderCapability: Our product capabilities extend beyond tissue into selected personal-care and incontinence categories, supported by experienced manufacturing and supply partners.

exportExperience.body: Unikota has export experience across Asia, Africa and North America, including Hong Kong, the United States, Nigeria, Singapore, Madagascar, Thailand, Indonesia, Mauritius and India.

finalCta.title: Have a product, brand or custom project in mind?
finalCta.body: Talk to Unikota about product development, private label, custom packaging, bulk supply, corporate projects or export requirements.
